description: Fresh Water Resources is a data set listed in Bahrain Open Data Portal (data.gov.bh), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by Meteorological Directorate\Ministry of Transportation and Telecommunications. It can support water resources and water supply network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-data-gov-bh-portal.
